tasks.label: Build Miximus (Windows)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $vswhere = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86')) 'Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe'; $vsInstall = & $vswhere -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath; if (-not $vsInstall) { throw 'Visual Studio C++ tools not found' }; Import-Module (Join-Path $vsInstall 'Common7/Tools/Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'); Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath $vsInstall -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=amd64 -host_arch=amd64'; cmake --preset windows-cef-release; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build --preset windows-cef-release --parallel 8; exit $LASTEXITCODE
